## HOST A BLISSFUL ISLAND WEDDING AMIDST BALI’S SCENIC SHORES & SACRED  FORESTS

Discover
**Bali, Indonesia — India’s top international wedding**
**destination**, where scenic beaches, cliffside venues, lush forests, and
Indian-friendly culture create a dreamy romantic escape. Perfect
for couples seeking the best Bali destination wedding, this island
blends spiritual charm with tropical luxury.


From top-rated venues like The Edge to luxury resorts at Ayana
Resort and Bulgari Resort, Bali offers unparalleled elegance.
Imagine a beachfront ceremony, a cliffside vow exchange, or a
forest reception — every moment glows with love and magic.


At Humsafar Weddings, we craft your perfect Bali wedding with
expert planning, seamless coordination, and heartfelt care —
delivering the best international destination wedding experience.


Because in Bali, your wedding isn’t just an event — it’s an exotic
love story woven with culture and beauty.


### WHY CHOOSE BALI FOR YOUR DREAM WEDDING?

ss


- **Top wedding venues**: The Edge, Ayana Resort, Bulgari
Resort

- Perfect mix of Hindu-friendly culture and luxury wedding vibes

- Ideal for beach weddings, cliffside vows, or forest ceremonies

- Unique Bali highlights: tropical sunsets, Balinese rituals, lush
greenery

- **Best Time**: April to October
- **Visa Info**: Visa on Arrival (30 days, ~$35 USD,
extendable)


![Udaipur Lake View](https://humsafar-wedding.netlify.app/images/world/Bali/Portrait.png)

## Top Destination Wedding Venues in Bali Indonasia

### _THE EDGE, BALI_

- **Rooms:** 8
- **Banquets & Lawns:** Private cliffside lawns and
decks for up to 100 guests; no formal indoor banquet hall

- **Distance from Airport (Ngurah Rai International**
**Airport):** 17 km (~30–45 minutes)

- **Distance from Railway Station:** Not applicable (No
railway system in Bali)


![The Oberoi Udaivilas](https://humsafar-wedding.netlify.app/images/world/Bali/The-Edge.jpg)

![ITC_Hotels_Ekaaya](https://humsafar-wedding.netlify.app/images/world/Bali/Ayana-Resort.jpg)

### _AYANA RESORT & SPA, BALI_

- **Rooms:** 294
- **Banquets & Lawns:** Indoor banquet hall up to 300
guests; Outdoor garden venues up to 500+ guests

- **Distance from Airport (Ngurah Rai International**
**Airport):**
12 km (~20–30 minutes)

- **Distance from Railway Station:** Not applicable (No
railway system in Bali)


### _BULGARI RESORT, BALI_

- **Rooms:** 59
- **Banquets & Lawns:** Indoor venues (The Pavilion) for 100+ guests; Outdoor options including oceanfront lawns and villa terraces up to 150–200 guests

- **Distance from Airport (Ngurah Rai International**
**Airport):** 16 km (~25–30 minutes)

- **Distance from Railway Station:** Not applicable (No
railway system in Bali)
